items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: He used to play with Louis DeMaine.

ctx.x: Nat Tolles. Nat Tolles is from here. He used to play with Louis DeMaine. And he went up there and made the Queen and everything. See Monroe, they've got a bridge between it. Desiree's speech, that's DeMaine's speech. They've got East Monroe and West Monroe and he had a band out of Army Hall in Nebraska and got a little Joe, one of his trumpet players, blew his way. He kind of, I don't know, they say he was off, but he's around here somewhere. Now, he played for plenty of trumpet, he don't play with nobody. He…
